title: A2A task lifecycle states require bridge-owned correlation
purpose: Illustrate why A2A task lifecycle states must not be presented as native OIX task-state semantics.

expected.description: A bridge may track A2A taskId/contextId and state in bridge-owned metadata, but must not imply that OIX v0.1 task.request/task.accepted/task.progress/task.result natively define A2A task lifecycle semantics. State translation requires a documented profile for terminal, intermediate, failure, timeout and cancellation behavior; preserve the original protocol state and correlation identifiers.

limitations: Illustrative data only; no live task or RPC.
State mapping is not normative for OIX or A2A.
No handling of streaming, push notifications, cancellation, retries, or race conditions is tested.
